title: JS8Call Directed Message Turnaround
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=js8call:message
| search msg_type=directed reply_latency_sec=*
| stats avg(reply_latency_sec) as avg_reply_latency_sec perc90(reply_latency_sec) as p90_reply_latency_sec count as samples by peer_call
| sort 0 - avg_reply_latency_sec
description: Measures JS8Call directed-message turnaround by peer call.
value: Turnaround time shows which contacts are flowing naturally and which ones are becoming store-and-forward conversations.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for JS8Call directed-message turnaround to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 JS8Call directed-message turnaround.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how long JS8Call directed-message turnaround usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
